posts.author: Nirriti
posts.body:
In RMMZ, you can set weapon animations for side-view battles party members. Initially, I thought you affixed those to weapons individually. But no, its in the System tab
(forgot about it)
. So I had to start splitting some wep. subtypes. Then it hit me as I was editing: I want to rename these animations.
Now, Its easy to edit the sprite sheets. But the selection in the dropdown menu
(Dagger/sword/flail/axe...)
is natively
SET IN STONE
. I could
(but shouldnt)
edit it somewhere in the main files, but I fear Ill miss something and cause issues. I rather not run off a chart on the side to remind myself which is which
(ex: Club = actually is a rapier)
down the line. Worse case scenario, Ill default to that. My RPG will have classical weapons and some splitting a few subtypes. So, I dont need StunGun/Chainsaw/RailGun/etc.
I would like to rename these
, basically
(added a screenshot to clarify).
What would be the simplest way to achieve that?
I do not want to resort to V.S. plugins
(personal reasons).
Thanks in advance! ^^

posts.author: sunhihi
posts.body:
I've always felt that
RPG Maker
has design issues in this area, so I wrote a plugin to address it. It allows you to set a separate image for each weapon individually—but you'll need to slice the weapon images beforehand.
Since I also created two other weapon formats, if you're not using them, don't enable them.
SunMZ武器紙娃娃 v3.3.0 by sunhihi
sunhihi.itch.io

I think you’ve already figured out the difference between <Weapon Type Data List> and <Weapon Image Data List>. If you’re willing to set up each weapon individually, the <Weapon Type Data List> can be ignored.
There are two lines of settings because the layers distinguish between before and after the character.
The settings for SV images are actually based on the following template.
But I actually don't recommend using this, as it requires handling a large amount of assets. The images provided in my example are meant for <weaponCustImage>.
You can set custom action modules in . By default, I have only created a slashing module, and I haven't made any other modules.
The alignment parameters for SV images can be set in . The reason for placing them here is to allow you to configure different settings for each character.
I finished this plugin a while ago, but since I've assigned myself a lot of other tasks, I haven't created the supporting templates. However, everything should function properly.
